svg.title: Case 001: fake FPS booster to njRAT and XWorm
svg.desc: A fake FPS booster ZIP hides two chains: FpsBooster.exe, resource icon_data XOR to njRAT 0.7d (kira-lab-c2[.]ddns[.]net:5552); tools/Updater.exe, overlay reversed base64 gzip to XWorm 5.6 (AES key MD5 of mutex, Telegram bot). Static analysis only, never run.
svg.text: Two delivery chains in one ZIP, both configurations decrypted, nothing executed.
tool: unmask · static analysis only · lab replica · T1027 · T1140 · T1547.001
